[0;32mUsage: [0m[0;33mhm ai-init [-|--platforms] [-|--types] [-|--resources] [-|--repository] [-|--branch] 
[0m[0;32mExample: [0m[0;33mhm ai-init
	 hm ai-init --platforms=claude,cursor --types=hyva,magento --resources=skills,agents
[0m[0;32mDescription:[0m Initialize AI tools configuration (skills/agents) via interactive wizard
[0;32mOptions:
[0m   [0;33m[-|--platforms] [0m Comma-separated list of AI platforms (claude, cursor, codex, copilot, gemini, opencode)
   [0;33m[-|--types]     [0m Comma-separated list of skill types (hyva, acs, magento, php)
   [0;33m[-|--resources] [0m Resource types to download (skills, agents, or both)
   [0;33m[-|--repository][0m Custom repository URL to include
   [0;33m[-|--branch]    [0m Branch name for custom repository (default: main)
